title: Sunset Vista Haven Pool Games 7 bedroom W/ Casita
description:
Welcome to *Sunset Vista Haven*, a stunning 7-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom retreat in Cave Creek, Arizona! Perfect for families & groups, this spacious home offers a large pool, a covered patio for outdoor dining & a sports court for friendly competition & fun! 
Inside, enjoy the space of 2 kitchens, a pool table & plenty of room for activities & hosting! With breathtaking desert sunsets & panoramic views, Sunset Vista Haven is the ideal escape for relaxation, adventure & unforgettable gatherings!

review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Ellie's place was awesome for our large group. Everyone had their own private area as needed, but also plenty of room to hang out and relax. There was lots to do in the immediate area and plenty of shops/grocery stores. She also answered any questions in a timely manner.
We had a great stay! Ellie’s house was wonderful, we really appreciated how family friendly it was and all the toys available for the kids. We would recommend this for a fun family stay!

Wonderful rental for multiple families! We stayed here with 4 families and 7 kids. The kids loved the pool, sport court and all the toys. Good restaurants nearby and not too far from the airport. Definitely recommend!
